method_transition.summary: Motivated by the advances of multi-modal pre-training , we propose a Support-Set Based Cross- Supervision, termed Sscs, to improve multi-modal relation learning for video grounding in a supervision way compared with the hand-designed architectures.

evidence.quote: Motivated by the advances of multi-modal pre-training [28, 33, 29], we propose a Support-Set Based Cross- Supervision, termed Sscs, to improve multi-modal relation learning for video grounding in a supervision way compared with the hand-designed architectures.

method_transition.summary: Our contributions are summarized as three-folds: (a) We introduce a novel cross-supervision module for video grounding, which can enhance the correlation modeling between videos and texts but not bring in the extra inference cost.

evidence.quote: Our contributions are summarized as three-folds: (a) We introduce a novel cross-supervision module for video grounding, which can enhance the correlation modeling between videos and texts but not bring in the extra inference cost.

method_transition.summary: (b) We propose to apply support-set concept to address the mutual exclusion of video entities, which make it is more suitable to apply contrastive learning for video grounding.

evidence.quote: (b) We propose to apply support-set concept to address the mutual exclusion of video entities, which make it is more suitable to apply contrastive learning for video grounding.

method_transition.summary: (c) Extensive experiments illustrate the effectiveness of Sscs on three public datasets, and the results show that our method can significantly improve the performance of the state-of-the-art approaches.

evidence.quote: (c) Extensive experiments illustrate the effectiveness of Sscs on three public datasets, and the results show that our method can significantly improve the performance of the state-of-the-art approaches.
